rollbackProcedure: Identify the exact deployed release SHA.
Select the most recent previously verified release SHA.
Rebuild that SHA through the protected release workflow; do not reuse an unverified local dist directory.
Verify artifact SHA-256 evidence before deployment.
Run post-deploy read-back and smoke checks.
Record incident, rollback SHA and recovery evidence.
prohibited: Do not rollback by manually editing generated dist files.
Do not treat development main as an automatic production rollback target.
Do not bypass release evidence because a prior build was green.
